data_root.description: Filesystem path where Docker stores all persistent state: images, containers, volumes, and networks. Ensure the partition has sufficient space (100 GB+ recommended for production).

storage_driver.description: Union filesystem driver for image layer storage. overlay2 is the recommended driver on Linux kernels 4.0+ with ext4 or xfs.

storage_opts.description: Additional options passed directly to the storage driver (e.g. overlay2.size=20G to cap container rootfs size). Leave empty to use driver defaults.

items.description: A key=value option string accepted by the configured storage driver

log_level.description: Minimum severity level written to the daemon log. Accepted values: debug, info, warn, error, fatal. Use info in production; debug is very verbose.

log_driver.description: Default logging driver for all containers. json-file and local support automatic rotation via log-opts. Other options: journald, syslog, fluentd, awslogs.

log_max_size.description: Maximum size of a single container log file before it is rotated. Applies to the json-file and local drivers. Suffix: k (kilobytes), m (megabytes), g (gigabytes).

log_max_file.description: Number of rotated log files to retain per container. Applies to the json-file and local drivers. Total on-disk log space per container is log_max_file × log_max_size.

live_restore.description: Keep containers running when dockerd is stopped or upgraded. Enables zero-downtime daemon upgrades. Disable only if your orchestrator (e.g. Kubernetes) manages container lifecycle directly.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug-level output in the daemon log. Produces high log volume; use only when diagnosing daemon issues, never in steady-state production.

cgroup_driver.description: cgroup management driver passed to the OCI runtime. Use systemd on all systemd-based Linux hosts (required for Kubernetes). Use cgroupfs only on non-systemd hosts.

max_concurrent_downloads.description: Maximum number of image layers pulled from a registry in parallel during a single docker pull. Increase on high-bandwidth networks; decrease to limit registry load.

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of image layers pushed to a registry in parallel during a single docker push. Increase on high-bandwidth networks.

dns_servers.description: DNS resolver addresses injected into /etc/resolv.conf of every container. Override with your internal resolvers when containers need to resolve private hostnames.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of a DNS resolver (e.g. 10.0.0.53)

dns_search.description: DNS search domains appended in every container's resolv.conf. Useful for resolving short hostnames within your internal domain without a FQDN.

bridge_ip.description: CIDR block assigned to the docker0 bridge interface. Change this when 172.17.0.0/16 conflicts with existing host routes or VPN subnets.

default_address_pools.description: Parent CIDR pools from which Docker allocates subnets for user-defined bridge networks. Each docker network create carves a /size subnet from the matching pool.

base.description: Parent CIDR block to allocate subnets from (e.g. 172.18.0.0/16)

size.description: Prefix length of each individual network subnet carved from the pool (e.g. 24 yields /24 networks)

userland_proxy.description: Use a userland proxy process for loopback-bound container port mappings. Disable (false) to rely on iptables DNAT, which has lower latency and resource overhead.

iptables.description: Allow dockerd to manage iptables rules for container port publishing and network isolation. Set to false only if you manage firewall rules externally and understand the implications.

ip_forward.description: Enable kernel IP forwarding (net.ipv4.ip_forward) so containers can communicate with networks beyond the local host. Required for most container networking scenarios.

registry_mirrors.description: Pull-through cache registries consulted before the upstream registry (e.g. Docker Hub). Use an internal mirror to reduce egress bandwidth and improve pull latency. Leave empty to pull directly.

items.description: Full URL of a registry mirror including scheme (e.g. https://mirror.corp.example.com)

insecure_registries.description: Registries that dockerd may contact over plain HTTP or with untrusted TLS certificates. Restrict to internal private registries only; never add public registries.

items.description: host:port of an insecure registry (e.g. registry.corp.example.com:5000)

metrics_enabled.description: Enable the built-in Prometheus metrics endpoint. When true, the daemon listens on metrics_addr and exposes engine metrics at /metrics. Requires experimental to be active.

metrics_addr.description: host:port on which the daemon serves Prometheus-format engine metrics. Only used when metrics_enabled is true. Bind to 127.0.0.1 and scrape via localhost or a local Prometheus agent.
